info.title: DynaCamp
info.summary: Dynamic campaign engine: map, fronts, forces, logistics, ATO, events.
info.description: Positions come as `pos` = [east, north] metres on the theater plane and `ll` = [lat, lon]. Times are `{t, label}` with `t` in campaign seconds. Every response is taken under the engine lock, so it describes a consistent state between two engine steps.

get.description: Whether commands need a token and whether the one sent (if any) is valid.
Clock, factions and objectives, connected players.
Provinces with territory polygons, links, airbases. Geometry never changes: load it once.
Front lines, front sectors with local force ratios, battles.

409 if the server was started without `--save`, 500 if the file cannot be written.
